def pages_needed(items, per_page):

    Imagine a storefront that displays its catalogue in fixed-size pages
    and needs the page count before it can draw the navigation bar. items

    Here items is the total number of entries in the catalogue, and
    per_page is the fixed capacity of a single page. Return the number of
    pages needed to hold all items, computed as
    (items + per_page - 1) // per_page with integer floor division
    (0 items need 0 pages).

    0
